key_facts: FINAL-DAY UPDATE Sat Aug 22 (T+1d to Sun Aug 23 10:04am ET Silesia DL; SUBMITTED: Alison dos Santos 0.45->0.48, Karsten Warholm 0.42->0.39, Ezekiel Nathaniel 0.06, Abderrahman Samba 0.035, Caleb Dean 0.015; sum=0.980, outside=0.020): (1) Aug 22 press conference (AFP/France24 13:37) & previews (FloTrack, Athletics Weekly) confirm full top field intact with no withdrawals (dos Santos, Warholm, Samba, Nathaniel, Dean, Bassitt, Lima all starting). (2) H2H & FORM VERIFICATION: Confirmed via Al Jazeera (July 18) that Warholm's 46.61 London DL win was in dos Santos's absence, so dos Santos is genuinely 3-0 H2H vs Warholm in 2026, holds the 46.48 WL, and is unbeaten in 3 career races in Silesia (AFP Aug 22). Adjusting H2H slightly from 51.7/48.3 to 55.2/44.8 (0.48 vs 0.39) while respecting Warholm's 45.94 WR and 46.28 Silesia MR.
